content.value_statement: Production incidents need fast triage across logs, metrics, traces, and cloud platforms. This skill guides structured DevOps debugging, root cause analysis, and recovery planning.
actual_capabilities: Guides incident triage using logs, metrics, traces, and system state.
Helps investigate Kubernetes pods, services, networking, storage, and resource constraints.
Supports cloud troubleshooting across AWS, Azure, GCP, and serverless services.
Frames performance analysis for applications, databases, caches, and infrastructure.
Structures root cause analysis, postmortems, monitoring improvements, and runbook updates.
Covers CI/CD, GitOps, artifact, and deployment failure investigation.
limitations: It provides guidance and checklists, not direct access to production systems.
It requires accurate incident details, logs, metrics, traces, and environment context.
It does not replace testing, change approval, or expert review for critical fixes.
It cannot confirm root cause without validation in the affected environment.

use_cases.title: Triage a Production Incident
use_cases.description: Use structured questions to assess impact, gather telemetry, form hypotheses, and choose the next safe action.

use_cases.title: Debug Kubernetes Failures
use_cases.description: Investigate pods, services, networking, storage, autoscaling, and resource limits with a clear troubleshooting flow.

use_cases.title: Improve Reliability After an Outage
use_cases.description: Turn incident findings into postmortem notes, monitoring gaps, runbook updates, and long-term resilience improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Start Incident Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me triage a production incident. Ask for the minimum details needed, then give a prioritized investigation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Kubernetes Restarts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for container platform debugging.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze recurring Kubernetes pod restarts. Consider resource pressure, health checks, events, logs, deployments, and recent changes.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Performance Bottleneck
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide a root cause analysis for high latency in a microservices system. Use metrics, traces, logs, dependencies, and capacity signals.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Recovery and Prevention Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an incident recovery plan and prevention plan. Include validation steps, monitoring improvements, runbook updates, and postmortem topics.

output_examples.input: Our API is returning intermittent 504 errors behind a load balancer.
output_examples.output: The response starts by confirming scope, recent changes, and affected routes. It then prioritizes load balancer health, upstream saturation, timeout settings, dependency latency, and trace correlation.

output_examples.input: Several Kubernetes pods are OOMKilled after a new deployment.
output_examples.output: The response compares old and new resource usage, recent image changes, memory limits, node pressure, application logs, and rollback options.

output_examples.input: A CI/CD pipeline fails during deployment to staging.
output_examples.output: The response separates build, artifact, credential, environment, and GitOps sync failures. It includes validation checks and rollback considerations.

best_practices: Start with impact, scope, recent changes, and the fastest safe validation path.
Correlate logs, metrics, traces, events, and deployment history before choosing a fix.
Document hypotheses, actions, evidence, and follow-up work during the incident.
anti_patterns: Do not apply fixes before confirming blast radius, rollback path, and approval requirements.
Do not rely on one telemetry source when other evidence contradicts it.
Do not close an incident without prevention work, monitoring updates, and shared learning.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands on my systems?
faq.answer: No. It provides troubleshooting guidance and asks for evidence. You control any commands or changes.

faq.question: Can it help during active production incidents?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to organize triage, evidence gathering, mitigation, and recovery planning.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Kubernetes, containers, AWS, Azure, GCP, observability platforms, CI/CD systems, databases, and networking.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide symptoms, impact, timestamps, recent changes, logs, metrics, traces, errors, and the environment involved.

faq.question: Can it write a postmortem?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help structure timeline, impact, root cause, contributing factors, actions, and prevention work.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for an SRE?
faq.answer: No. It supports investigation and documentation, but critical changes still need qualified human review.
